title: Spectral Rank Analysis at FK Aggregation: Measuring Information Compression Across 3 Contrasting Tasks
summary: Demo notebook for the Spectral Rank Analysis at FK Aggregation experiment. Loads pre-computed results from 3 RelBench tasks (rel-f1/driver-dnf, rel-trial/study-adverse, rel-stack/user-engagement) and demonstrates core rank computation functions (SVD effective rank, variance-entropy proxy, compression ratio) using NumPy. Includes synthetic embedding demo, parsing of experimental results into DataFrames, cross-task severity correlation analysis, and 4-panel visualization of compression ratios, SVD-proxy correlation, severity vs CAMA benefit, and key findings summary.
